capabilities: Search movies by title, year, or IMDB ID via OMDb
Create movie notes in a configurable folder
Download movie images into an assets folder
extras: Requires a folder named movies (configurable Main Path) and a folder named assets (configurable Image Path) in the vault; trailer retrieval needs a YouTube API key that may be hard to obtain.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to look up movie information or trailers and turn them into notes.

relations.evidence: crawl movie data from omdb and Youtube trailers
You need to get an API key from Youtube and set it in the plugin settings

summary: Movie data plugin that searches OMDb for film information and YouTube trailers and saves them as notes in the vault.
